svg.title: Bottom Edges
svg.desc: Two lower strips from the Metropolitan Museum's photographs of Design for a cabinet and Head of a Man, held to the same approximate physical scale using their recorded sheet dimensions. The cabinet drawing's handwritten line sits farther above the edge than the stamp and handwriting on Legros's sheet.
svg.text: The last seven centimetres from two sheets, held to one scale.
Edge distances are approximate readings of the collection photographs.
